title: Palisades (Holtec restart): Fixed Fee Cap for Palisades Nuclear Plant Exigent License Amendment Request Review (EPID L-2026-LLA-0201) [['E-Mail']]

documents.text:
Brent Ballard

From:                             Brent Ballard
Sent:                             Tuesday, October 13, 2026 7:29 AM
To:                               ext_KYLE_STEFFIC; Kami Miller
Cc:                               Justin Poole; Marlayna Doell; Ilka Berrios
Subject:                          Fixed Fee Cap for Palisades Nuclear Plant Exigent License Amendment Request Review
                                  (L-2026-LLA-0201)


Licensee: Palisades Energy, LLC
Plant: Palisades Nuclear Plant
License No.: DPR-20
Docket No.: 50-255
EPID: L-2026-LLA-0201

In accordance with 10 CFR 170.33, this communication establishes the ﬁxed cap on service fees (ﬁxed fee cap) for
the NRC’s review of Palisades Energy, LLC’s application dated September 30, 2026 (ML26273A469), as
supplemented by letters dated October 2, 2026, October 8, 2026, and October 12, 2026 (ML26275A214,
ML26281A333, and ML26285A034 respectively), for the Palisades Nuclear Plant exigent license amendment.

The ﬁxed fee cap for the NRC’s review of this requested activity is $185,000. The NRC considered various factors
when establishing this ﬁxed fee cap, such as the quality and complexity of the application, technology type, and
any pre-application engagement. The professional hourly rate applies to this requested activity.

The ﬁxed fee cap represents the maximum amount that the NRC may charge for service fees for this requested
activity. The ﬁxed fee cap will not be increased except in instances of applicant failure, as deﬁned in 10 CFR 170.3.
If applicant failure occurs, the NRC will notify the licensee in writing of the new ﬁxed fee cap, which will be set at
the lowest practicable amount determined by the NRC to account for the applicant failure and complete the
review.

The NRC will track service fees against the ﬁxed fee cap beginning on September 30, 2026, which is the date of the
licensee’s application.

Disputes associated with a ﬁxed fee cap must be submitted in accordance with 10 CFR 15.31 and 170.33(f) and
NRC Form 529 procedures.


Brent Ballard
Project Manager
Operating Reactor Licensing Branch 3
Division of Licensing Projects 1
Office of Nuclear Reactor Regulation
U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
